note: Private campground on Silvers Lake (Chain of Five Lakes) with 1,000 ft of lake frontage, a sandy beach and pontoon, kayak and canoe rentals; grassy, shaded sites. Daily/weekly/monthly/seasonal mix with genuine nightly bookings. RV Life coord was off ~0.5 km E; corrected. --Claude
summary: Operator site (new owners, the Van Dykes) confirms 100 sites, 30-amp + water at nightly sites, showers/laundry/store/dump/Wi-Fi, online booking via ResNexus, and overnight camping until Oct 15 (seasonals to Oct 31). Cleared the Allstays-only 45-ft max. No nightly rate posted anywhere on the operator site; ResNexus answered the read with its anti-scraping captcha, so fees stay empty. Phone 517-857-2200 confirmed. Note trimmed of what the fields now hold and the Allstays length.
flags: No posted nightly rate: the operator site lists none and the ResNexus booking engine returned its anti-bot captcha page (2026-10-22). Price indicator is the booking engine plus RV Life $$. Seasonal share not published: all 100 sites are offered 'for Seasonal, Monthly, Weekly or Daily', with a separate nightly site type (water + 30 A, grassy) and seasonals staying to Oct 31; reviews describe a lively seasonal community. Presence passes (operator website + phone 517-857-2200).
